recipe.visualDefinition: A high-key, desaturated studio portrait of a male subject positioned on the left, balanced by bold, wide-tracked sans-serif typography on the right against a clean, neutral background.
coreVisualRelationships: Asymmetrical balance between the subject on the left and text on the right
High-contrast relationship between dark clothing/text and a bright background
Direct eye-line from the subject's sunglasses towards the viewer
Text alignment centered vertically relative to the subject's torso
coreInvariants: Ample negative space on the right third of the frame

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Subject is medium-shot, cropped at the hips, occupying the left two-thirds of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's dark sunglasses and facial expression act as the primary anchor.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The viewer's eye starts at the subject's face, moves down the body, and follows the horizontal line to the text on the right.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Significant white/light gray space on the right side to accommodate typography.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Light gray/white background providing a high-key base.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep charcoal and black for the subject's clothing and sunglasses.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Solid black for the typography to ensure maximum legibility.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Near-zero saturation with a focus on tonal values ranging from highlights to deep shadows.
paletteRestrictions: Limited to grayscale or very muted cool tones

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single typeface family used for all elements to maintain minimalism.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the geometric structure and modern editorial feel.
Similar geometric proportions and clean lines.
Classic geometric sans that fits the minimalist aesthetic.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a high-key, grayscale studio portrait of a man in a v-neck sweater and sunglasses, positioned on the left side of the frame with a seamless white background on the right.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add uppercase geometric sans-serif text in the middle-right negative space with wide tracking and a solid black fill.

verificationChecks: Is the text clearly separated from the subject?
Is the tracking on the text wide enough to feel editorial?

adjustableVariables: Specific shade of gray in the background

mustAchieve: Clean, sharp focus on the subject

postGenerationChecks: Ensure no color bleed in the grayscale image
Check that the subject's crop feels intentional and balanced
Confirm the background is a smooth gradient or flat tone
recipe.reuseFormula: Grayscale Studio Portrait + Left-Aligned Subject + Right-Aligned Wide-Tracked Geometric Sans
